svg.title: Matched cold export-library race shard
svg.desc: GitHub took 19 minutes 4 seconds. Blacksmith took 11 minutes 45 seconds. Both passed the same 112 subtests. One trial per provider.

g.text: Blacksmith shortened the matched cold shard by 38.4%
Each provider ran once with the same source, container and selected tests.
We tested one workload. We have not measured the effect on full CI or time to merge.
